status: Provisional mounting and open gallery-boundary study; not a complete lubrication circuit

factory.instruction: Replace original insert with the anti-drainback service insert; filter gasket contacts the cylinder-block sealing surface before an additional half turn.
factory.limit: No insert drawing, internal valve mechanism, dimensions or bore layout is provided. The modeled hollow comparison insert is not claimed to reproduce the E4TZ service remedy. Torque is a source fact, not a strength validation.

comparison.visual_review: Page rendered and inspected. EQ-OFA302 photo shows hollow stepped externally threaded ends, intermediate shoulder, and an internal drive recess. Table lists Ford4.9L/300 in1970–1996 engine group, D7AZ6890A cross-reference.
comparison.limit: Not established as E4TZ6890A equivalent. Photograph does not dimension threads, lengths, bore or drive recess.

mounting_reference.visual_review: Rendered and inspected typical inclined filter mount with central projecting stud and surrounding block sealing face. Architecture only; not a dimensioned1994truck drawing.

circuit_reference.visual_review: Factory lubrication schematic inspected directly; filter on the cam/main-gallery side, pump delivery to filter, and central longitudinal gallery supplying cam/main bearings and hydraulic tappets. Pressure-switch branch and gallery end plugs are shown. No dimensions are inferred from this schematic.
circuit_reference.boundary_rationale: The factory describes a complete pressurized circuit. This candidate stops visibly at two separate boss-side openings instead of implying that blind holes already reach that still-unmodeled network.

explicit_limits: Two open side bores are sectional-study interfaces, not production external ports. Their coordinates are emitted by gallery_boundaries(). They must not be mistaken for a complete or oil-tight engine.
Pump discharge and main-gallery connections beyond those boundaries remain absent, rather than terminating in hidden dry block material.
No invented service-insert check ball, spring, flap, standpipe or extra bypass mechanism is installed.
Existing disposable-filter anti-drainback flap and illustrative bypass remain distinct. Their presence does not establish the service insert remedy or pressure/flow behavior.
No separate adapter gasket is inferred. The existing filter mounting gasket seats on the continuous boss land; metal insert shoulder/contact details remain provisional.
